introHtml: Custom 3 oz shot glasses offer a generous serving size that stands out from standard 1.5 oz options. Ideal for promotional events, corporate parties, or branded giveaways, these glasses provide ample space for logos and designs. Whether you choose glass for a premium feel or plastic for durability, the extra capacity makes them versatile for both shots and small servings of other beverages. Perfect for imprinting with your brand message.
